meaning.en: A small brick, typically made of charcoal and typically used for fuel.

sentences.vi: Các sản phẩm than cho cư dân là than bánh, bánh than, than tổ ong và than nung.

sentences.en: The production technique of said briquet is reliable, its process is simple and raw material resource is secure. Besides, it has the condition of continuously industrial production.

sentences.en: The optimization of the prescription of solid fuel briquet by orthogonal design is reported in detail.

sentences.en: In this paper, effect of dispersion rate on briquet quality and different factors which influence dispersion rate of sewage sludge in fine coal were studied.

sentences.en: The clogging of a briquet hole is prevented; a plurality of combustible gas is provided for the combustion chamber, promoting the sufficient combustion of the briquet.
sentences.vi: Ngăn chặn sự tắc nghẽn của lỗ đóng bánh; một lượng lớn khí dễ cháy được cung cấp cho buồng đốt, thúc đẩy quá trình đốt cháy đầy đủ của than bánh.
